e.title: Humanize Chinese
e.summary: 检测/改写 AI 味中文（去AI味/降AIGC）：中文内容质量把关
e.body: Humanize Chinese skill（agentic-awesome-skills 收录）检测并改写 AI 味中文，支持学术场景降 AIGC（知网/维普检测风格）与风格转换。对本站：AI 萃取内容的质量把关——与 [[prompt-engineering]]（生成端）配合，生成后过一遍去 AI 味；你的 IFA 去主观化规则本质就是此类实践，可形式化成可复用检查。适用 [[deepseek]] 等中文生成场景。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：SKILL.md 内容（去AI味/降AIGC工作流）已读，未实测
e.summary_en: Detect/rewrite AI-flavored Chinese (de-AI / reduce AIGC): quality gate for Chinese content
e.summary_hk: 檢測/改寫 AI 味中文（去AI味/降AIGC）：中文內容質量把關
e.body_en: The Humanize Chinese skill (curated in agentic-awesome-skills) detects and rewrites AI-flavored Chinese, supporting academic AIGC reduction (CNKI/Wanfang-style checks) and style conversion. For this site: a quality gate for AI-extracted content — used with [[prompt-engineering]] (generation side), run the output through de-AI-fication; your IFA de-subjectivization rules are essentially this practice and can be formalized into a reusable check. Applies to Chinese generation with [[deepseek]] and similar models.
e.body_hk: Humanize Chinese skill（agentic-awesome-skills 收錄）檢測並改寫 AI 味中文，支持學術場景降 AIGC（知網/維普檢測風格）與風格轉換。對本站：AI 萃取內容的質量把關——與 [[prompt-engineering]]（生成端）配合，生成後過一遍去 AI 味；你的 IFA 去主觀化規則本質就是此類實踐，可形式化成可復用檢查。適用 [[deepseek]] 等中文生成場景。
